note: War and occupation (1939-45) meant almost no local recording; the wartime songs everyone knew (Czerwone maki na Monte Cassino, Warszawskie dzieci, Pałacyk Michla, Serce w plecaku) circulate today only in later recordings and are omitted because the recording artist/year could not be pinned down. Two pre-war Fogg/Ordonówna evergreens included as what postwar Warsaw cafés and radio still played. Fogg ran his own label from 1947.
